releaseNotes:
- Seerr Category "See More" Browse Pages: Added "See More" cards at the end of every Requests row (Your Recent Requests, Trending, Upcoming Movies, Upcoming TV Series) opening a dedicated paginated grid page that dynamically loads more results as you scroll.
- Seerr Detail & Status Improvements: Added release dates (First Aired for TV shows; Theatrical and Digital release dates for movies), full non-truncated TV descriptions, immediate "Requested" poster badge updates after submitting a request, and persistence for the last selected Seerr server.
- TV Navigation & Scroll Fixes: Fixed D-pad cursor returning to the left nav after pressing Right from the library reorder toggle button, fixed Requests bottom-row focus getting stuck after returning from Your Recent Requests, and aligned category & search grid scrolling so previous-row years stay off-screen.
- Android TV Updater Reliability: Fixed an issue where the Android TV updater could close without launching the system installer on the first attempt, added an install-permission check, and prevented duplicate update modals from appearing on app resume.
- App Version Bump: v1.11.1 (versionCode 60)
